63b3f1dd2142.en: The Buhraies brought English-speaking humans into the mix and used memory and mind manipulation to take away their language. But language is such an embedded part of the soul that some of it kept on: when humans took over, the basic idea of building an alphabet stuck around, and its letters naturally fell in the same order as in English.
63b3f1dd2142.t: 布莱斯把说英语的人类带了进来，用记忆和心智操控夺走了他们的语言。但语言深深嵌在灵魂里，所以有一部分保留了下来：人类接管之后，构建字母表的基本概念留了下来，它的字母也自然而然地按照和英语相同的顺序排列。

7387d3b040ac.en: A logographic language created by the ancient species, because Darfaries can't use the ancient species' interfaces. It has two parts: Subject and Verb.
7387d3b040ac.t: 一种由古老物种创造的语素文字，因为达尔法里斯无法使用古老物种的界面。它分为两部分：主语和动词。

9a438b3dac9e.en: "Sanbi shit" is a common saying, used where someone from our world would say "hell". It's mostly said in Sanbi, or by people who came from there: a telltale sign someone spent time there, along with being more carefree and loudmouthed. (World Lore Q&A › Vol 4 Draft 2, Q6.)
9a438b3dac9e.t: “桑比屎”是一句常用语，用在我们世界的人会说“见鬼”的地方。它主要在桑比说，或者由来自那里的人说：这是一个人在那里待过的明显标志，另外还有更无忧无虑、嗓门更大。（世界观问答 › Vol 4 Draft 2，Q6。）

9e241025fc81.en: Darfaries interface compound objects: a table of wavy-line symbols for storm, steam, lava, ash, mist, hail, gravity and more, labeled in Vraki and English.
9e241025fc81.t: 达尔法里斯界面复合对象：一张由波浪线符号组成的表，表示风暴、蒸汽、熔岩、灰烬、薄雾、冰雹、重力等，用弗拉基文字和英文标注。

a46139d4dbab.en: A logographic language that grew out of the Finaies interface language, because of the mix of blood and Soul Energy.
a46139d4dbab.t: 一种从菲奈斯界面语言发展出来的语素文字，因为血液与灵魂能量的混合而产生。

a86d73ccb002.en: On this website, Vraki is 1:1 with English. A "Complex Vraki" language does exist, but it's left out here for the sake of simplicity, in a world already chock-full of lore. To learn more about the original Vraki writing system, see the Vraki website.
a86d73ccb002.t: 在本网站上，弗拉基语与英语是 1:1 对应的。确实存在一种“复杂弗拉基语”，但为了简单起见，这里没有收录，毕竟这个世界的设定已经满满当当了。想了解更多关于原始弗拉基书写系统的信息，请参阅弗拉基网站。

b8f85ae6c1d8.t: 菲奈斯界面语标文字：表示电击、重力、火、水、空气和土的简单线条符号。

bf4fd9fe3de5.en: So Vraki is mostly English with a skin, since English is the common language of business communication and the language Deo wrote everything in. Old Vraki is Old English, with some random stuff thrown in.
bf4fd9fe3de5.t: 所以弗拉基语基本上就是换了一层皮的英语，因为英语是商务交流的通用语言，也是 Deo 写下一切所用的语言。古弗拉基语就是古英语，再随便混进一些东西。

d7a2a0da2aab.t: 弗拉基字体现已开放给所有人下载，并可用于自己的创作。非商业用途免费，但须注明出处。商业用途需要获得批准并支付费用，为了支持社区，面向艺术家和创作者的费用会保持在较低水平；详见字体许可证。
